info.title: Movo proposed application API
info.description: Proposed schema for the complete web/mobile design reviewed 2026-10-03. No listed application route is verified deployed. Authoritative host is NestJS; Supabase Auth is called directly with the SDK. Supabase supplies PostgreSQL. Cross-field/domain constraints in descriptions require runtime validation and transactional enforcement. Read docs/features/supabase-app-schema.md for live readiness findings and open product decisions.

SupabaseAccessToken.description: Verified Supabase Auth user access token. Anonymous Auth identities allowed only on the web guest path; application ownership always from verified token.

SportId.description: Positive PostgreSQL bigint as decimal string. Runtime must reject values above 9223372036854775807.

anyOf.description: end_hour > start_hour; full 7–21 selection normalized to null. Preferred time is a target; actual free-time fit is mandatory.

Preferences.description: One source-of-truth JSON per person. Empty activity_interests requires explore; catalog references validated at runtime. preferred_company is proposed for the web and requires agreement.

Sport.description: Unique metric keys; no calories. Each non-gym log has exactly one required duration metric stored as seconds. Preview rows are not generation-enabled.

Slot.description: Half-open interval; end > start, runtime validated.

Availability.description: Sorted non-overlapping free slots only. Manual is explicitly supplied by the user. A denied/error calendar read cannot produce slots. Slots are ephemeral; receipts persist their canonical input hash, not the interval payload.

GymExercise.description: Catalog-owned exercise ID. Sets are uniformly reps or time for one exercise. Never contains planned weight.

examples.name: Leg press
examples.description: Move slowly through a comfortable range.

PlannedActivity.description: Stable UUID across moves/shortening. Gym/non-gym shape, catalog references, part/set total duration, unique exercises and beginner scope are runtime validated.

PlanSnapshot.description: Monday local week. Zero activities is valid. Unique activity IDs, at most one planned session per local day, no overlaps, and sessions fitting week/free slots are runtime checks.

GeneratePlanInput.description: expected_version is 0 for a new week or that week's active version. sport_id null allows mobile discovery from saved interests. Validate allowed current/next week, saved answers, catalog support, availability, quota; no slots produces an empty snapshot.

StartActivityInput.description: Only an eligible gym activity in its canonical week can start. Lock against concurrent revisions.

MetricValues.description: Values and keys validated against the owned activity sport's catalog revision; canonical units; no calories.

MetricSources.description: Exactly the supplied metric keys. Planned default is user-confirmed, not inferred actual performance.

ExerciseLog.description: Unique set indices and exercise IDs. Referenced planned exercise and tracking kind must match for planned completions.

Feedback.description: Exactly one owned target link; opinion null means no opinion. Reset preserves effort and notes.

CompleteActivityInput.description: Original owned version must contain the activity. No duplicate completion across versions. Match duration metric to actual_duration_seconds; reject future completion beyond documented clock-skew tolerance. Early end still completes.

ExtraWorkout.description: History only; never included in planned progress. Created through validated chat. Deleted extras no longer provide summary evidence.

Calendar.description: Only canonical version per week, including locked outcomes. Extras separate. No private events. Page merged results via next_cursor; max 31-day query span.

SendChatInput.description: Server reads authoritative history. Availability required to schedule/move; missing free-time context yields clarification, not invented slots. Extra logging can clarify and save without availability. Skip is an explicit state transition committed with a version change.

ActivityChange.description: Computed by server from validated snapshots and outcome transitions, not trusted AI diffs.

UndoPlanInput.description: Target must be the immediate prior snapshot of the newest eligible change in the same owned week. Restore as a new immutable version, preserve all logged/locked records; otherwise 409.

PreferenceEvidence.description: Server verified fact snapshot from a preference JSON pointer at the cited revision. Old snapshots are displayed only with the summary marked stale/updating.

FeedbackEvidence.description: Server verifies ownership, current fact and nondeleted log; never treats skip or missing opinion as a dislike.

Summary.description: Derived, no write authority. Saved only after semantic evidence validation; excludes name/email/steps/calendar contents from model context.

SummaryState.description: Retain previous validated text marked updating during refresh; failed generation hides summary without hiding answers. Server compares source revisions before replacing derived content.

GuestBootstrapResult.description: Only verified anonymous identity. Seed once per owner even across distinct bootstrap request IDs. Reject normal accounts; never overwrite real data with demo data.
